accepted.s: The 30th CII Partnership Summit, held in November 2025, was associated with which of the following outcomes?
o: 756 projects involving ₹21.64 lakh crore and 11 lakh jobs
25 projects involving ₹2.01 lakh crore and 16 lakh jobs
610 MoUs involving ₹13.25 lakh crore and approximately 16 lakh jobs
accepted.x: The 30th CII Partnership Summit held at Visakhapatnam in November 2025 resulted in 610 MoUs, investments of ₹13.25 lakh crore and approximately 16 lakh jobs.
accepted.tq: Match the forum with its distinctive investment and employment figures.
accepted.sec: Investment summits and MoUs - forum, venue, investment, partner + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The 31st CII Partnership Summit is scheduled to be held at which place and on which dates?
accepted.x: The 31st CII Partnership Summit is scheduled at Visakhapatnam on 12–13 November 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the venue-date pair to distinguish closely related summit entries.
accepted.sec: Investment summits and MoUs - forum, venue, investment, partner + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: What is the theme of the 31st CII Partnership Summit?
o: Navigating change: Leadership, technology, trust and trade
Building a Resilient and Inclusive India
accepted.x: The stated theme of the 31st CII Partnership Summit is “Navigating change: Leadership, technology, trust and trade...”.
accepted.tq: Test the exact official wording rather than a broad thematic substitute.
accepted.sec: Investment summits and MoUs - forum, venue, investment, partner + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the World Economic Forum meeting at Davos in 2026:
1. Lokesh met Japan’s JERA regarding green ammonia.
2. An MoU relating to the UAE Food Cluster was signed on 21 July 2026 in Amaravati.
3. The UAE Food Cluster MoU was associated with APEDB.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The Davos engagement involved JERA, while the UAE Food Cluster MoU was signed in Amaravati on 21 July 2026 with APEDB.
accepted.tq: Link the international meeting, partner, date and implementing body before selecting the coded option.
accepted.sec: Investment summits and MoUs - forum, venue, investment, partner + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: At the WEF Davos engagement, Japan’s JERA was associated with green-ammonia proposals at which locations in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: JERA was associated with green-ammonia proposals at Moolapeta, Krishnapatnam and Kakinada.
accepted.tq: Discriminate among location clusters associated with different projects.
accepted.sec: Investment summits and MoUs - forum, venue, investment, partner + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: APEX Korea — AP’s first overseas investment facilitation centre
UAE Food Cluster — Dugarajapatnam shipbuilding cluster
accepted.x: The UAE Food Cluster was linked to an MoU with APEDB. The Dugarajapatnam shipbuilding cluster was the subject of invitations to Korean firms through APEX Korea.
accepted.tq: Find the project-partner swap among otherwise familiar investment associations.
accepted.sec: Investment summits and MoUs - forum, venue, investment, partner + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: APEX Korea, described as Andhra Pradesh’s first overseas investment facilitation centre, is located at:
accepted.x: APEX Korea is located at Busan, South Korea, and functions as Andhra Pradesh’s first overseas investment facilitation centre through APEDB.
accepted.tq: Use the location clue to distinguish the facilitation centre from the country’s capital.
accepted.sec: Investment summits and MoUs - forum, venue, investment, partner + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The APEX Korea initiative invited Korean firms to participate in which Andhra Pradesh project?
accepted.x: Through APEX Korea, Korean firms were invited to participate in the ₹30,000-crore Dugarajapatnam shipbuilding cluster.
accepted.tq: Match the overseas facilitation centre with the sector-specific investment opportunity.
accepted.sec: Investment summits and MoUs - forum, venue, investment, partner + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: What was the reported aggregate value and duration of projects in Andhra Pradesh over the stated period of 23 months?
accepted.x: A total of 756 projects worth ₹21.64 lakh crore were reported over 23 months.
accepted.tq: Separate aggregate project figures from summit-specific and SIPB-specific figures.
accepted.sec: Investment summits and MoUs - forum, venue, investment, partner + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The State Investment Promotion Board cleared 87 proposals worth approximately:
accepted.x: The SIPB cleared 87 proposals with an investment value of approximately ₹34,000 crore in June 2026.
accepted.tq: Pair the proposal count with the corresponding value rather than the larger aggregate investment total.
accepted.sec: Investment summits and MoUs - forum, venue, investment, partner + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes Google’s anchor investment in Andhra Pradesh?
o: An 800-MW hybrid renewable project at Kanekallu
A 1-GW AI data centre at Tarluvada in Visakhapatnam
accepted.x: Google’s anchor investment is a 1-GW AI data centre at Tarluvada in Visakhapatnam.
accepted.tq: Match the investor with the exact project type, capacity and location.

accepted.s: The Google AI data-centre project at Tarluvada is part of an investment of $15 billion, equivalent to approximately:
accepted.x: The Google data-centre investment is part of a $15-billion programme, stated as approximately ₹1.35 lakh crore.
accepted.tq: Convert and distinguish the foreign-currency headline figure from project-specific rupee figures.
accepted.sec: Investment summits and MoUs - forum, venue, investment, partner + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which combination of entities was associated with the Google AI data-centre project at Tarluvada?
accepted.x: The Tarluvada AI data-centre project was associated with Google, Adani and Airtel Nxtra; it covered 601 acres and its foundation stone was laid on 28 April 2026.
accepted.tq: Identify the associated partners instead of confusing them with energy-sector investors.

accepted.s: ArcelorMittal Nippon Steel’s proposed 8.2 MTPA plant is located at:
accepted.x: The 8.2 MTPA ArcelorMittal Nippon Steel plant is proposed at Rajayyapeta near Anakapalli, with the foundation stone laid on 23 March 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the location and capacity together to identify the steel project.
accepted.sec: Investment summits and MoUs - forum, venue, investment, partner + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which company is associated with the proposed 2 MTPA steel plant at Kadapa?
accepted.x: JSW Steel is associated with the proposed 2 MTPA steel plant at Kadapa.
accepted.tq: Test the investor-project association through a direct industrial matching question.

accepted.s: The 17th SIPB meeting held in May 2026 approved which combination of projects, investment and employment?
o: 25 projects, ₹2.01 lakh crore and more than 39,000 jobs
610 projects, ₹13.25 lakh crore and 16 lakh jobs
accepted.x: The 17th SIPB meeting, chaired by the Chief Minister, approved 25 projects involving ₹2.01 lakh crore and more than 39,000 jobs.
accepted.tq: Match the meeting number with its precise project, investment and employment bundle.
accepted.sec: Investment summits and MoUs - forum, venue, investment, partner + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the headline approvals of the 17th SIPB:
1. Reliance’s data centre in Visakhapatnam involved ₹1,08,010 crore.
2. Reliance’s solar and battery-storage project was located in Sri Sathya Sai district.
3. Adani’s pumped-storage project was located in Kadapa.
4. Yamanko’s green-hydrogen project was located in Tirupati.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. The respective investments included Reliance’s ₹1,08,010-crore data centre, Reliance’s ₹51,300-crore solar-storage project, Adani’s ₹12,297-crore Kadapa project and Yamanko’s ₹9,398-crore Tirupati project.
accepted.tq: Check each project against both its investor and district before choosing the combination.
accepted.sec: Investment summits and MoUs - forum, venue, investment, partner + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched with its investment value?
accepted.x: Yamanko’s green-hydrogen project at Tirupati involved ₹9,398 crore. ₹51,300 crore was associated with Reliance’s solar and battery-storage project in Sri Sathya Sai district.
accepted.tq: Locate the swapped numerical value in an otherwise correctly associated project pair.
accepted.sec: Investment summits and MoUs - forum, venue, investment, partner + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: According to the Chief Minister’s figure stated on 15 August 2026, which combination is correct?
o: ₹2.01 lakh crore of proposals, ₹34,000 crore approved and 39,000 jobs
₹34,000 crore of proposals, ₹24 lakh crore approved and 14 lakh jobs
₹24 lakh crore of proposals, ₹14 lakh crore approved and 11 lakh jobs
₹21.64 lakh crore of proposals, ₹13.25 lakh crore approved and 16 lakh jobs
accepted.x: The stated figures were ₹24 lakh crore in proposals, ₹14 lakh crore approved and 11 lakh jobs as of 15 August 2026.
accepted.tq: Keep proposal, approval and employment figures in their correct order.
accepted.sec: Investment summits and MoUs - forum, venue, investment, partner + sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Tata Renewable Energy hybrid project comprises:
o: 400 MW solar at Kanekallu and 800 MW wind at Pathikonda
800 MW solar at Kurnool and 400 MW wind at Kadapa
400 MW solar at Pathikonda and 400 MW wind at Kanekallu
800 MW wind at Hulikera and 400 MW solar at Pudimadaka

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding recent power-sector measures in Andhra Pradesh is correct?
o: RE projects of 112.45 GW were allocated in June 2026.
PM Surya Ghar rooftop systems in Andhra Pradesh numbered 50,000 in August 2026.
RDSS works for rural power networks were limited to ₹522 crore.
The State Distribution Reforms Committee was chaired by the Chief Minister.
accepted.x: Renewable-energy projects totalling 112.45 GW were allocated in June 2026. PM Surya Ghar systems numbered 4.11 lakh, rural-network RDSS works were about ₹10,000 crore, and the committee was chaired by the Chief Secretary.
accepted.tq: Identify the single precise statement among figures and authority swaps.
accepted.sec: Energy projects and power reforms → district + capacity  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Andhra Pradesh had approximately how many PM Surya Ghar rooftop systems in August 2026?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh had 4.11 lakh PM Surya Ghar rooftop systems in August 2026 and was among the top four states.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the statewide rooftop-system count from the separate 50,000-connection target.
accepted.sec: Energy projects and power reforms → district + capacity  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements about solar development in Andhra Pradesh is correct?
1. Ultra-mega solar parks are located in Kurnool and Kadapa.
2. Fifty thousand acres of barren land were offered for solar leases in April 2026.
3. The APPSC 2024 key identified solar plants in Anantapur and West Godavari.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: ultra-mega solar parks are in Kurnool and Kadapa, 50,000 acres were offered for solar leases, and the APPSC 2024 key identified Anantapur and West Godavari for solar plants.
accepted.tq: Combine locations, land extent and the examination-key reference without reversing the district pairs.
accepted.sec: Energy projects and power reforms → district + capacity  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The State Distribution Reforms Committee cleared ₹522 crore of loss-reduction works for which event?
accepted.x: The committee, chaired by the Chief Secretary, cleared ₹522 crore of loss-reduction works for Godavari Pushkaralu 2027.
accepted.tq: Match the reform allocation with the event for which the works were cleared.
accepted.sec: Energy projects and power reforms → district + capacity  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about pumped-storage projects is NOT correct?
o: A 1,344-MW pumped-storage project was under study.
The Upper Sileru PSP was reported as already commissioned.
The 800-MW Avuku PSP of RVR Projects was cancelled in September 2026.
Adani’s pumped-storage project in Kadapa was approved.
accepted.x: The Upper Sileru PSP was planned, not already commissioned. The Adani Kadapa project was approved, a 1,344-MW project was under study, and the 800-MW Avuku PSP was cancelled in September 2026.
accepted.tq: Reject the option that changes a planned project into a completed one.
accepted.sec: Energy projects and power reforms → district + capacity  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The AP-Transco transmission loss during 2025–26 was reported as:
accepted.x: AP-Transco’s transmission loss during 2025–26 was reported as 2.6%.
accepted.tq: Use the exact percentage rather than substituting a nearby project capacity or expenditure figure.
accepted.sec: Energy projects and power reforms → district + capacity  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
accepted.x: APSPDCL was associated with 50,000 rooftop solar connections. Kurnool-IV REZ had 4.5 GW capacity, rural-network RDSS works were about ₹10,000 crore, and the Adani PSP was in Kadapa.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following events in chronological order:
A. Foundation stone laid for the ArcelorMittal Nippon Steel plant
B. Foundation stone laid for the Google AI data centre
C. 17th SIPB meeting
D. APEX Korea established at Busan
accepted.x: The correct order is A (23 March 2026), B (28 April 2026), C (May 2026) and D (July 2026).
accepted.tq: Fix the dated foundation-stone events first, then place the meeting and overseas centre.
